prompt: Inside a modern art museum gallery, ten canvas paintings hang evenly spaced on white walls. Each painting is illuminated by its own spotlight as visitors stroll beneath. Six sculptural pieces—marble busts, bronze statues, and wooden totems—stand on raised pedestals. A glass display case holds a collection of ceramics, while a row of benches invites guests to sit. A wall-mounted touchscreen kiosk shows exhibition information next to a brochure rack filled with pamphlets. A security camera and an emergency exit sign are visible above. There is no graffiti, no plastic toy, no paper map, no cardboard box, and no neon sign.
